A layout-table row keeps an image as Markdown instead of degrading it to alt text

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<table><tr><td><img src=\"a.svg\" alt=\"A\"> <a href=\"/1\">x</a></td><td><a href=\"/2\">y</a></td></tr><tr><td><a href=\"/3\">z</a></td></tr></table>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
